faqs.question: What's the dress code?
faqs.answer: Formal attire. Dress to impress and help us celebrate!

faqs.question: Can I bring a plus one?
faqs.answer: We've done our best to accommodate everyone. Please check your invitation for the names of those invited. If your invitation says 'and guest,' you're welcome to bring a plus one!

faqs.question: What time should I arrive?
faqs.answer: The most polite thing you can do is plan to arrive at 6, no need to be early.

faqs.question: Is there parking at the venue?
faqs.answer: Street parking is limited. We recommend taking a rideshare (Uber/Lyft) or CTA to get to the venue. Complimentary shuttles will run from the venue back to the hotel blocks starting at 9:00 PM.

faqs.question: How do I get to the venue?
faqs.answer: We recommend rideshare (Uber/Lyft) or CTA. We will have shuttles running from the venue back to the hotel blocks starting at 9:00 PM.

faqs.question: Where should I stay?
faqs.answer: We've reserved room blocks at the Westin River North and Courtyard Marriott River North with group rates for guests. There are also a bunch of other hotels and Airbnb options in the area. Booking links for our room blocks are live now. Head to our Travel page to reserve your room!

faqs.question: Will there be food options for dietary restrictions?
faqs.answer: In addition to offering a vegetarian option, we can accommodate any allergen or restriction. Please let us know when you RSVP and we'll make sure you're taken care of.

faqs.question: What's the music situation?
faqs.answer: We will have a lot of live musicians celebrating with us. Because of that, there will not be requests. But you're in good hands.

faqs.question: Can I take photos during the celebration?
faqs.answer: We'd love for you to capture the fun! Just be mindful during special moments. Our photographer will be there to get the big shots, so relax and enjoy the night.

faqs.question: What's the weather like in August?
faqs.answer: August in Chicago is warm with temperatures typically between 70°F and 85°F. However, Chicago weather can be unpredictable! We recommend bringing a light layer for the evening.

faqs.question: Who do I contact with questions?
faqs.answer: For any questions, please reach out to us directly. You can email us at hankinsreedwedding@protonmail.com and we'll get back to you as soon as possible!
